hypotheses.name: Selective continuity beats maximal continuity
hypotheses.hypothesis: The useful Clay memory variable is not persistence volume but selective causal availability: bounded truthful context assembled from persistent state should outperform both full-history context and retrieval-only on a subset of long-horizon tasks.
hypotheses.counter: Any continuity gain disappears against a sufficiently strong retrieval/context-engineering baseline.
hypotheses.falsifier: no Pareto region where selective continuity improves quality at matched facts/compute/tokens
hypotheses.test: long-context-only vs retrieval-only vs CACC dual-path factorial

hypotheses.name: Anti-attractor utility learning
hypotheses.hypothesis: CACC salience adaptation needs explicit diversity/novelty and anti-lock-in controls in addition to truth immutability; otherwise utility feedback can form self-confirming associative attractors.
hypotheses.counter: lateral inhibition/decay alone prevents harmful lock-in.
hypotheses.falsifier: utility learning without diversity controls shows no excess lock-in or OOD recall loss under adversarial reward history
hypotheses.test: online utility poisoning x inhibition x diversity-budget factorial with frozen truth ledger

hypotheses.name: Causal rail audit
hypotheses.hypothesis: Every model-facing rail P1/P2/P3/hybrid should be evaluated with controlled message substitution separating channel presence, same-example content and other-agent value, because end-task accuracy and feature retention are non-identifying.
hypotheses.counter: ordinary end-task and semantic-equivalence tests are sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: substitution components add no explanatory or predictive power across target tasks

hypotheses.name: Nested workspace mediation
hypotheses.hypothesis: A FRANK WorkspaceEpisode improves some higher-order decisions only when its projection is taken up into a privileged model-internal workspace-like representation; system selection and model uptake are separable causal stages.
hypotheses.counter: no privileged mediating internal workspace exists in target Qwen; ordinary distributed computation explains effects.
hypotheses.falsifier: workspace effect survives targeted internal representation lesion/swap unchanged or no stable privileged readout exists

hypotheses.name: External recurrence rescue
hypotheses.hypothesis: Truthful provenance-bound re-entry can act as an external recurrence scaffold that selectively rescues multi-step performance when model-internal workspace capacity/depth is limited.
hypotheses.falsifier: shuffled/equal-content re-entry rescues equally after token/order controls
hypotheses.test: internal-workspace lesion x re-entry OFF/truthful/shuffled with matched visible information

hypotheses.name: Typed IR is an external convergence point
hypotheses.hypothesis: ClayCode's strongest defensible role is a typed semantic IR that separates generative intent from deterministic verification/lowering and from target-specific reader/platform surfaces, rather than merely a denser notation.
hypotheses.counter: direct model-generated code/JSON with conventional validation matches typed IR on correctness, portability and cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: typed IR yields no reduction in semantic/portability defects under mutation and cross-target tests
hypotheses.test: ClayCode vs direct JSON/code multi-target differential compiler benchmark

hypotheses.name: UnifiedDB is a semantic polystore fabric
hypotheses.hypothesis: UnifiedDB should optimize logical identity/query/transaction evidence across specialized stores rather than target physical unification; physical consolidation is a workload-specific optimization only.
hypotheses.counter: one optimized physical store/process Pareto-dominates the hybrid on FRANK traces.
hypotheses.falsifier: monolith dominates latency, RAM, energy, replay, provenance and recovery with equal semantics
hypotheses.test: trace-driven monolith vs polystore placement sweep

hypotheses.name: Effect-boundary policy enforcement
hypotheses.hypothesis: FRANK's authority broker should be implemented as complete mediation at the effect/tool boundary with cross-step provenance/sensitivity state; prompt/task-alignment checks are defense-in-depth, not the authority root.
hypotheses.counter: prompt/task-alignment enforcement is enough and a broker adds avoidable latency/complexity.
hypotheses.falsifier: prompt-only enforcement matches deterministic PEP/broker under identical-output indirect-injection, revocation and confused-deputy attacks

hypotheses.name: Bounded higher-order propagation
hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit n-ary/higher-order relations improve tasks with genuine group dependencies, but their activation propagation must be depth/budget/diversity bounded to avoid oversmoothing and overcoupling.
hypotheses.counter: pairwise typed graphs are sufficient, or unbounded higher-order propagation is always beneficial.
hypotheses.falsifier: n-ary encoding adds no OOD/role-binding benefit, or propagation shows no collapse/interference over depth
hypotheses.test: pairwise vs n-ary x propagation-depth/budget factorial

hypotheses.name: Multimetric emergence certificate
hypotheses.hypothesis: E-CERT2 should treat PEID/PID/effective-information measures as complementary lenses downstream of intervention identity; emergence promotion requires convergent lesion/rescue/OOD/multiscale evidence rather than one information scalar.
hypotheses.counter: one well-defined effective-information or synergy statistic is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: single scalar prospectively and uniquely predicts all preregistered causal lesion/rescue/OOD outcomes across candidate mechanisms

hypotheses.name: Full adaptation requires retained-capability homeostasis
hypotheses.hypothesis: Because full-model Clay adaptation is owner-fixed, training should treat retained general capability, OOD composition and authority behavior as homeostatic constraints alongside Clay loss, with tokenizer strategy as an independent factor.
hypotheses.counter: Clay-native training objective alone improves or preserves all needed capability.
hypotheses.falsifier: Clay-only checkpoint selection never degrades preregistered retained/OOD/authority suites across training
hypotheses.test: checkpoint trajectory x tokenizer strategy x rehearsal/retention control

hypotheses.name: Adaptive edge cognitive governor
hypotheses.hypothesis: On Android/edge, the optimal Clay configuration is a dynamic controller over Assembly size, retrieval escalation, KV precision/cache, prefill/decode and thermal state rather than a fixed context length or fixed rail.
hypotheses.counter: one static context/KV/rail configuration dominates target workloads.
hypotheses.falsifier: static configuration Pareto-dominates adaptive policy across sustained target traces

hypotheses.name: Scientific bottleneck has shifted to target causal replication
hypotheses.hypothesis: Further architecture synthesis has diminishing information gain until CACC/NWB mechanisms are causally tested on the exact Clay-adapted Qwen target with shuffled controls and independent replication.
hypotheses.counter: another architecture-generation cycle will reveal a missing mechanism that invalidates current experiments.
hypotheses.falsifier: pre-experiment architecture audit discovers an unresolved confound that prevents causal identification
hypotheses.test: prioritize target-Qwen continuity x nested-workspace factorial; architecture work only when a concrete confound demands it
